tasks.intent: In the studio-platform repo, add the Phase 2 tables for art shows (shows, show_artworks) so the API can record which artworks went to a show and which sold there.

checks.description: Adds a new numbered migration instead of editing the first one
Every new table belongs to a studio

tasks.intent: Add the action that marks an artwork sold at a show to a client, so the artwork, the show record and the client's history all update together and the artist can undo it.

checks.description: Built as a registered action, not a one-off route
Marking sold waits for the artist's confirm tap
Never turns money into a decimal number

tasks.intent: Build the endpoint that receives a phone's queued offline changes and applies them, so a retry after a dropped connection never applies the same change twice.

checks.description: Uses each change's operation id to make retries safe
Checks the record version the phone edited from
Never takes the studio from what the phone sent

tasks.intent: Build the endpoint a device calls to fetch everything that changed since it last synced, including records that were deleted.

checks.description: Takes the device's last sync point
Uses the activity log's running number as the sync point
Sends deletions too, so other devices remove them
